kp.label: Angle P
kp.description: Main proportional angle response. Higher values make the board respond more strongly to nose angle error.

kp2.label: Rate P
kp2.description: Responds to angular velocity. This acts like damping and is especially noticeable during fast or aggressive nose-angle changes.

ki.label: Angle I
ki.description: Integral angle correction. This helps remove sustained angle error over time.

ki_limit.label: I Term Limit
ki_limit.description: Limits how much authority the integral correction can build up.

mahony_kp.label: Pitch KP
mahony_kp.description: Pitch-axis Mahony filter accelerometer correction. Higher values feel looser and linger more; lower values feel snappier.

mahony_kp_roll.label: Roll KP
mahony_kp_roll.description: Roll-axis Mahony filter correction. Lower roll correction can help the nose hold up in turns and make tight carves feel stiffer.

kp_brake.label: Angle P (Braking)
kp_brake.description: Multiplier for angle response while braking.

kp2_brake.label: Rate P (Braking)
kp2_brake.description: Multiplier for rate response while braking.

atr_strength_up.label: ATR Uphill Strength
atr_strength_up.description: Nose lift applied from adaptive torque response during uphill or acceleration load.

atr_strength_down.label: ATR Downhill Strength
atr_strength_down.description: Nose lowering applied from adaptive torque response during downhill or braking load.

atr_threshold_up.label: Threshold Angle Up
atr_threshold_up.description: Angle threshold before uphill ATR behavior starts.

atr_threshold_down.label: Threshold Angle Down
atr_threshold_down.description: Angle threshold before downhill ATR behavior starts.

atr_speed_boost.label: Speed Boost
atr_speed_boost.description: Boosts ATR response as speed increases.

atr_angle_limit.label: Tiltback Angle Limit
atr_angle_limit.description: Maximum angle ATR tiltback is allowed to apply.

atr_on_speed.label: Max Tiltback Speed
atr_on_speed.description: Maximum speed where ATR tiltback can be applied.

atr_off_speed.label: Max Tiltback Release Speed
atr_off_speed.description: Maximum speed where ATR tiltback can be released.

atr_transition_boost.label: Tiltback Transition Boost
atr_transition_boost.description: Boost factor around ATR response transitions.

atr.transition_boost.label: Tiltback Transition Boost
atr.transition_boost.description: Boost factor around ATR response transitions.

atr_filter.label: Current Filter
atr_filter.description: Current filter frequency used by ATR.

atr_amps_accel_ratio.label: Amps to Acceleration Ratio
atr_amps_accel_ratio.description: Ratio used by acceleration-side ATR behavior.

atr_amps_decel_ratio.label: Amps to Deceleration Ratio
atr_amps_decel_ratio.description: Ratio used by deceleration-side ATR behavior.

turntilt_strength.label: Strength
turntilt_strength.description: Turn tiltback strength. The basic Carve tilt control writes this directly. Tune Preview does not show it because Carve Tilt requires a turn scenario.

turntilt_start_angle.label: Turn Aggregate Threshold
turntilt_start_angle.description: Turn aggregate threshold before turn tiltback response starts.

turntilt_start_erpm.label: ERPM Threshold
turntilt_start_erpm.description: ERPM threshold before turn tiltback response starts.

turntilt_speed.label: Max Tiltback Speed
turntilt_speed.description: Maximum speed where turn tiltback can be applied.

turntilt_erpm_boost.label: Speed Boost %
turntilt_erpm_boost.description: Speed-based boost percentage for turn tiltback.

turntilt_erpm_boost_end.label: Speed Boost Max ERPM
turntilt_erpm_boost_end.description: ERPM where turn tiltback speed boost reaches its maximum.

turntilt_yaw_aggregate.label: Turn Aggregate Target
turntilt_yaw_aggregate.description: Target accumulated yaw or turn value for turn tiltback.

torquetilt_strength.label: Strength
torquetilt_strength.description: Nose lift based on positive output current. The basic Nose stiffness control writes this value.

torquetilt_strength_regen.label: Strength (Regen)
torquetilt_strength_regen.description: Nose lowering based on negative regen current. The basic Tail stiffness control writes this value.

torquetilt_start_current.label: Start Current Threshold
torquetilt_start_current.description: Current threshold before torque tiltback starts.

torquetilt_angle_limit.label: Tiltback Angle Limit
torquetilt_angle_limit.description: Maximum angle torque tiltback is allowed to apply.

torquetilt_on_speed.label: Max Tiltback Speed
torquetilt_on_speed.description: Maximum speed where torque tiltback can be applied.

torquetilt_off_speed.label: Max Tiltback Release Speed
torquetilt_off_speed.description: Maximum speed where torque tiltback can be released.

braketilt_strength.label: Brake Tilt Strength
braketilt_strength.description: Brake tilt strength. The basic Brake tilt control writes this directly.

braketilt_lingering.label: Brake Tilt Lingering
braketilt_lingering.description: Controls how brake tilt lingers or releases after braking.

tiltback_constant_erpm.label: Constant Tiltback ERPM
tiltback_constant_erpm.description: Forward speed threshold where Constant Tiltback begins.

tiltback_variable_erpm.label: Variable Tiltback Start ERPM
tiltback_variable_erpm.description: Forward speed threshold where Variable Tiltback begins.

fault_is_dual_switch.label: Both zones as one (Posi)
fault_is_dual_switch.description: Either zone can keep the board on, so heel-lift dismount won't work. A stuck sensor can keep it running after you step off.

fault_delay_switch_half.label: One zone off, cutoff after
fault_delay_switch_half.description: How long one zone can stop sensing your foot before the board switches off. Applies at low speed, with Posi off.

fault_delay_switch_full.label: Both zones off, cutoff after
fault_delay_switch_full.description: How long both zones can stop sensing your foot before the board can switch off.

fault_moving_fault_disabled.label: Moving faults disabled
fault_moving_fault_disabled.description: Stops the footpad from switching the board off while riding forward fast enough and fairly level. It can keep going after you step off.

fault_darkride_enabled.label: Darkride
fault_darkride_enabled.description: Allows riding upside down without footpad sensors.

enable_quickstop.label: Quickstop
enable_quickstop.description: Lets you brake hard and lift your front foot as the wheel stops, with the nose tilted up.

startup_simplestart_enabled.label: Simple start
startup_simplestart_enabled.description: Lets you start with just one footpad zone pressed. Heel-lift dismount still works.

startup_pushstart_enabled.label: Push start
startup_pushstart_enabled.description: Lets you hop onto a rolling board even if the nose isn't level yet. Needs a little speed to engage.

startup_dirtylandings_enabled.label: Dirty landings
startup_dirtylandings_enabled.description: Briefly gives you more room to land with the nose tilted after a hop. Doesn't apply after a heel-lift dismount.

fault_reversestop_enabled.label: Reverse stop
fault_reversestop_enabled.description: Lets you dismount by rolling back a little. The board tilts, then switches off. Makes balancing in place harder.
